registeredAssertions.inputSource: Same frozen one-cell synthetic v2 tomato run and 80-day sunnySeries used by the existing A-07 test; model inputs are crop-model-v2/run-inputs-v2/crop-parameters-v3. The crop cultivar and production/root parameter accuracy are not assessed.
registeredAssertions.preManualPool: A no-harvest prefix through dayIndex 62 reaches harvestReadyDay 62, biomassFrac 1, and 252 g/m2 dry matter using the preregistered toBeCloseTo(252, 8) precision. stepDay applies dayIndex 63 manual harvest before that day's growth, so this is the pool consumed by the manual payout.
registeredAssertions.automaticArm: Exactly one event for cell 0,0 on dayIndex 62 / 2026-12-02, payout 0.007875 kg within 1e-12 kg; total and per-crop summaries exactly 0.01 kg.
registeredAssertions.singleManualArm: Exactly one manual request for cell 0,0 on dayIndex 63 / 2026-12-03, one event and 0.007875 kg payout within 1e-12 kg; automatic/manual payout difference <=1e-12 kg; total and per-crop summaries exactly 0.01 kg.
registeredAssertions.replay: Repeated execution of each arm from the same frozen inputs and its exact environment series yields equal events, finalState, and summary.
registeredAssertions.duplicateRequestCase: The pre-existing two-request idempotency case is unchanged and remains a separate assertion.

assumptions: Reuse the existing frozen one-cell tomato inputs and sunnySeries in the existing v2 test.
Keep the code change test-only and leave duplicate-request suppression separate.
Do not change production equations or introduce new tolerances.

evidenceBoundary: This result verifies deterministic event routing, one-cell synthetic payout conversion, summary aggregation, and per-arm replay for two management modes. It does not establish crop or cultivar accuracy, biological maturity, measured-trial agreement, reference-model agreement, predictive validity, or the remaining A-07 spacing, mortality, target, management, and golden coverage.
